description: Digip helps users classify goods and services, create trademark conflict search reports, and review existing reports in their Digip account. Users can inspect regional risk summaries, conflicting marks, filing-probability labels, and available report notes, then open the full report in Digip. Creating a report consumes one search from the customer's quota; refining a classification replaces its saved content.
